card.name: Million and billion scale words
card.fires_on: Large-number scale words such as millions, billions, trillions, crores and gigahertz, often just before 'of' (e.g. 'millions of years'). Also fires partway through these words, such as Bill-ions or cro-res.

modes.label: Whole scale word
modes.description: The full word millions or billions, usually followed by 'of' and a count noun like years.
modes.example: it is impossible for them to have lasted for<< millions>> of years.

modes.label: Split scale word
modes.description: The ending piece of a split number word such as billions, trillions or crores.
modes.example: to add tr<<illions>> of dollars to the global GDP”.

modes.label: Unit scale words
modes.description: Scale endings in units or population counts, such as gigahertz or per one million.
modes.example: IENTS PER ONE MILL<<ION>> POPULATION PER YEAR FOR APLAST
